001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages;
002
003import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.MessageProps;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.bluetooth.Characteristic;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.models.UnexpectedOpCodeException;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.authentication.Jpake1aResponse;
008import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.authentication.Jpake1bResponse;
009import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.authentication.Jpake2Response;
010import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.models.UnexpectedTransactionIdException;
011import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.shared.JavaHelpers;
012import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.shared.L;
013
014import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.shared.Hex;
015
016import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
017
018import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
019import java.security.MessageDigest;
020import java.util.Arrays;
021import java.util.Set;
022
023
024public class PacketArrayList {
025    protected static final String TAG = "PacketArrayList";
026    public static final String IGNORE_INVALID_HMAC = "IGNORE_HMAC_SIGNATURE_EXCEPTION";
027    public static boolean ignoreInvalidTxId = false;
028
029    protected byte expectedOpCode;
030    protected byte expectedCargoSize;
031    protected int actualExpectedCargoSize;
032    protected byte expectedTxId;
033    protected boolean isSigned;
034    protected byte[] fullCargo;
035    protected byte[] messageData;
036
037    /**
038     * Messages whose framed cargo can legitimately be a little shorter than the size declared in
039     * their MessageProps. The JPAKE rounds embed a zero-knowledge-proof scalar which is encoded
040     * with its minimal length, so roughly 1 time in 256 per scalar the round is a byte shorter
041     * than its nominal length (see Jpake2Response.parse). Everything else has a genuinely fixed
042     * size and a mismatch there is an error.
043     */
044    private static final Set<Class<? extends Message>> SHORT_CARGO_TOLERANT_MESSAGES = Set.of(
045            Jpake1aResponse.class, Jpake1bResponse.class, Jpake2Response.class);
046
047    /** How many bytes shorter than the declared size such a cargo is allowed to be. */
048    private static final int MAX_SHORT_CARGO_BYTES = 4;
049
050    protected boolean tolerateShortCargo = false;
051
052    protected byte firstByteMod15;
053    protected byte opCode;
054    protected boolean empty = true;
055    protected final byte[] expectedCrc = {0, 0};
056
057    protected PacketArrayList(byte expectedopCode, byte expectedCargoSize, byte expectedTxId, boolean isSigned) {
058        Validate.isTrue(expectedopCode != 0);
059        Validate.isTrue(expectedCargoSize >= 0 || (256 + (int)expectedCargoSize) >= 0);
060        this.expectedCargoSize = expectedCargoSize;
061        if (expectedCargoSize < 0 && expectedCargoSize > -128) {
062            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 256 + expectedCargoSize;
063        } else {
064            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = expectedCargoSize;
065        }
066        this.expectedOpCode = expectedopCode;
067        this.expectedTxId = expectedTxId;
068        this.isSigned = isSigned;
069        this.fullCargo = new byte[(this.actualExpectedCargoSize + 2)];
070        this.messageData = new byte[3];
071    }
072
073    // Returns either PacketArrayList or StreamPacketArrayList depending on the opcode
074    public static PacketArrayList build(byte expectedopCode, Characteristic characteristic, byte expectedCargoSize, byte expectedTxId, boolean isSigned) {
075        Class<? extends Message> messageClass = Messages.fromOpcode(expectedopCode, characteristic);
076        L.t(TAG, String.format("queried messageClass for expectedOpcode %d, %s: expectedCargoSize=%d", expectedopCode, messageClass, expectedCargoSize));
077        MessageProps messageProps = messageClass.getAnnotation(MessageProps.class);
078        if (messageProps.stream()) {
079            return new StreamPacketArrayList(expectedopCode, expectedCargoSize, expectedTxId, isSigned);
080        }
081
082        PacketArrayList packetArrayList = new PacketArrayList(expectedopCode, expectedCargoSize, expectedTxId, isSigned);
083        packetArrayList.tolerateShortCargo = SHORT_CARGO_TOLERANT_MESSAGES.contains(messageClass);
084        return packetArrayList;
085    }
086
087    public byte[] messageData() {
088        return messageData;
089    }
090
091    public byte opCode() {
092        return opCode;
093    }
094
095    public byte getExpectedTxId() {
096        return expectedTxId;
097    }
098
099    public final boolean needsMorePacket() {
100        byte b = this.firstByteMod15;
101        return b >= 0;
102    }
103
104    private void createExpectedCrc() {
105        if (this.fullCargo.length >= 2) {
106            System.arraycopy(this.fullCargo, this.fullCargo.length - 2, this.expectedCrc, 0, 2);
107        }
108    }
109
110    public boolean validate(byte[] authKey) {
111        Validate.notNull(authKey, "ak");
112        if (needsMorePacket()) {
113            return false;
114        }
115        createMessageData();
116        createExpectedCrc();
117        byte[] a = Bytes.calculateCRC16(this.messageData);
118        byte[] lastTwoB = this.expectedCrc;
119        boolean ok = true;
120
121        if (!(a[0] == lastTwoB[0] && a[1] == lastTwoB[1])) {
122            ok = false;
123        }
124        // the fullCargo size is 2 + the message length.
125        L.t(TAG, "validate fullCargo size="+fullCargo.length+" ok="+ok);
126        if (!ok) {
127            if (shouldIgnoreInvalidHmac(authKey)) {
128                L.e(TAG, "CRC validation failed for: " + ((int) this.expectedOpCode) + ". a: " + Hex.encodeHexString(a) + " lastTwoB: " + Hex.encodeHexString(lastTwoB) + ". fullCargo len=" + fullCargo.length + " opCode="+opCode);
129            } else {
130                throw new InvalidCRCException("CRC validation failed for: " + ((int) this.expectedOpCode) + ". a: " + Hex.encodeHexString(a) + " lastTwoB: " + Hex.encodeHexString(lastTwoB) + ". fullCargo len=" + fullCargo.length + " opCode="+opCode+" authKey="+new String(authKey));
131            }
132        } else if (this.isSigned) {
133            L.t(TAG, "validate(" + Hex.encodeHexString(authKey) + ") messageData: " + Hex.encodeHexString(messageData) + " len: " + messageData.length + " fullCargo: " + Hex.encodeHexString(fullCargo) + " len: " + fullCargo.length);
134            byte[] byteArray = Bytes.dropLastN(this.messageData, 20);
135            byte[] bArr2 = this.messageData;
136            byte[] expectedHmac = Bytes.dropFirstN(bArr2, bArr2.length - 20);
137            byte[] hmacSha = Packetize.doHmacSha1(byteArray, authKey);
138            // MessageDigest.isEqual is the constant-time comparison; Arrays.equals returns as
139            // soon as it hits a differing byte.
140            if (!MessageDigest.isEqual(expectedHmac, hmacSha)) {
141                L.e(TAG, "Pump response invalid signature: expectedHmac=" + Hex.encodeHexString(expectedHmac)+" hmacSha="+Hex.encodeHexString(hmacSha));
142                if (shouldIgnoreInvalidHmac(authKey)) {
143                    return true;
144                }
145
146
147                throw new InvalidSignedMessageHMACSignatureException("Pump response invalid: SIGNATURE");
148            }
149        }
150        return ok;
151    }
152
153    protected void createMessageData() {
154        byte[] bArr = this.messageData;
155        bArr[0] = this.expectedOpCode;
156        bArr[1] = this.expectedTxId;
157        bArr[2] = this.expectedCargoSize;
158        this.messageData = Bytes.combine(bArr, Bytes.dropLastN(this.fullCargo, 2));
159    }
160
161    protected void parse(byte[] bArr) {
162        byte opCode = bArr[2];
163        int cargoSize = bArr[4];
164        if (cargoSize < 0 && cargoSize > -128) {
165            cargoSize += 256;
166        }
167        // ErrorResponse handling. Can have a dynamic cargo size in different situations.
168        if (77 == opCode && 2 == cargoSize) {
169            this.expectedOpCode = 77;
170            this.expectedCargoSize = 2;
171            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 2;
172            this.fullCargo = new byte[4];
173        } else if (77 == opCode && 26 == cargoSize) {
174            this.expectedOpCode = 77;
175            this.expectedCargoSize = 26;
176            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 26;
177            this.fullCargo = new byte[28];
178        }
179        // ApiVersionRequest can either have 0 cargo size or 2
180        // its cargo size is set as 2 in the MessageProps but we allow the 0-cargo here as well
181        if (32 == opCode && 0 == cargoSize) {
182            this.expectedCargoSize = 0;
183            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 0;
184        }
185        // CommonSoftwareInfoRequest can have cargo size 0 or 1
186        else if (-114 == opCode && 1 == cargoSize) {
187            this.expectedCargoSize = 1;
188            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 1;
189        }
190        // CommonSoftwareInfoResponse can have cargo size 60 or 51
191        else if (-113 == opCode && 51 == cargoSize) {
192            this.expectedCargoSize = 51;
193            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 51;
194        }
195        // HighestAamResponse can have cargo size 10 or 11
196        else if (121 == opCode && 10 == cargoSize) {
197            this.expectedCargoSize = 10;
198            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 10;
199        }
200        // DetectingCartridgeStateStreamResponse / LoadCartridgeStateStreamResponse
201        // can report either 2-byte progress or 1-byte state payloads.
202        else if (-29 == opCode && (1 == cargoSize || 25 == cargoSize)) {
203            this.expectedCargoSize = 1;
204            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 1;
205        } else if (-29 == opCode && (2 == cargoSize || 26 == cargoSize)) {
206            this.expectedCargoSize = 2;
207            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 2;
208        }
209        // ExitFillTubingModeStateStreamResponse / PrimeNudgeStateStreamResponse use 1 byte,
210        // while PumpingStateStreamResponse uses 5 bytes.
211        else if (-23 == opCode && (1 == cargoSize || 25 == cargoSize)) {
212            this.expectedCargoSize = 1;
213            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 1;
214        } else if (-23 == opCode && (5 == cargoSize || 29 == cargoSize)) {
215            this.expectedCargoSize = 5;
216            this.actualExpectedCargoSize = 5;
217        }
218
219
220
221        if (opCode == this.expectedOpCode) {
222            this.firstByteMod15 = (byte) (bArr[0] & 15);
223            this.opCode = bArr[2];
224            byte txId = bArr[3];
225            L.t(TAG, "PacketArrayList firstByteMod15="+firstByteMod15+" opCode="+opCode+" txId="+txId+" expectedTxId="+expectedTxId+" bArr="+JavaHelpers.display(bArr));
226            if (txId != this.expectedTxId) {
227                throwUnexpectedTransactionIdException(txId);
228            } else if (cargoSize != this.actualExpectedCargoSize) {
229                if (cargoSize == this.actualExpectedCargoSize + 24 && isSigned) {
230                    L.t(TAG, "adding +24 expectedCargoSize for already signed request which contains an existing trailer");
231                    expectedCargoSize += 24;
232                    actualExpectedCargoSize += 24;
233                } else if (this.tolerateShortCargo
234                        && cargoSize < this.actualExpectedCargoSize
235                        && cargoSize >= this.actualExpectedCargoSize - MAX_SHORT_CARGO_BYTES) {
236                    // A JPAKE round whose minimal-length ZKP scalar made it shorter than nominal.
237                    // The CRC and any signature are computed over the declared size, so shrink the
238                    // expected size rather than rejecting the message.
239                    L.t(TAG, "accepting short cargo size " + cargoSize + " for opCode=" + opCode
240                            + ", expected " + this.actualExpectedCargoSize);
241                    this.expectedCargoSize = (byte) cargoSize;
242                    this.actualExpectedCargoSize = cargoSize;
243                    this.fullCargo = new byte[cargoSize + 2];
244                } else {
245                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected cargo size: " + ((int) cargoSize) + ", expecting " + ((int) this.actualExpectedCargoSize) + " for opCode="+opCode);
246                }
247            }
248            this.fullCargo = Bytes.dropFirstN(bArr, 5);
249        } else {
250            throw new UnexpectedOpCodeException(opCode, this.expectedOpCode);
251        }
252        L.t(TAG, "PacketArrayParse ok: opCode="+opCode+" firstByteMod15="+firstByteMod15+" cargoSize="+cargoSize);
253    }
254
255
256    public void validatePacket(byte[] packetData) {
257        Validate.notNull(packetData, "packetData");
258        if (packetData.length == 0) {
259            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty data");
260        } else if (packetData.length >= 3) {
261            byte firstByteMod15 = (byte) (packetData[0] & 15);
262            byte secondByte = packetData[1];
263            L.t(TAG, "Found tx id: "+secondByte+" expected "+this.expectedTxId);
264            if (secondByte == this.expectedTxId) {
265                if (this.empty) {
266                    this.firstByteMod15 = firstByteMod15;
267                    L.t(TAG, "txid matches, firstByteMod15="+firstByteMod15+", parsing packetData");
268                    parse(packetData);
269                } else if (((byte) 0) == firstByteMod15) {
270                    L.t(TAG, "firstByteMod15=0");
271                    if (this.firstByteMod15 == firstByteMod15) {
272                        this.fullCargo = Bytes.combine(this.fullCargo, Bytes.dropFirstN(packetData, 2));
273                        L.t(TAG, "firstByteMod15 matches expected, fullCargo="+ Hex.encodeHexString(fullCargo));
274                    } else {
275                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected packets remaining 3: " + ((int) firstByteMod15) + ", expected " + ((int) this.firstByteMod15) + ", opCode: " + ((int) this.expectedOpCode));
276                    }
277                } else if (this.firstByteMod15 == firstByteMod15) {
278                    this.fullCargo = Bytes.combine(this.fullCargo, Bytes.dropFirstN(packetData, 2));
279                    L.t(TAG, "firstByteMod15 matches expected, nonzero, fullCargo=" + Hex.encodeHexString(fullCargo));
280                } else {
281                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected packets remaining 2: " + ((int) firstByteMod15) + ", expected " + ((int) this.firstByteMod15) + ", opCode: " + ((int) this.expectedOpCode));
282                }
283                this.empty = false;
284                this.firstByteMod15 = (byte) (this.firstByteMod15 - 1);
285                L.t(TAG, "validatePacket: decrementing firstByteMod15 to " + firstByteMod15);
286                return;
287            }
288            throwUnexpectedTransactionIdException(secondByte);
289        } else {
290            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid data size: " + packetData.length);
291        }
292    }
293
294    private void throwUnexpectedTransactionIdException(byte foundTxId) {
295        RuntimeException ex = new UnexpectedTransactionIdException(foundTxId, this.expectedTxId, this.expectedOpCode);
296        if (ignoreInvalidTxId) {
297            L.e(TAG, ex);
298            return;
299        }
300        throw ex;
301    }
302
303    private boolean shouldIgnoreInvalidHmac(byte[] authKey) {
304        return Arrays.equals(
305                Arrays.copyOfRange(authKey, 0, IGNORE_INVALID_HMAC.length()),
306                Arrays.copyOfRange(IGNORE_INVALID_HMAC.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), 0, IGNORE_INVALID_HMAC.length())
307        );
308    }
309
310    public String toString() {
311        return JavaHelpers.autoToString(this, Set.of());
312    }
313
314    public static class InvalidCRCException extends RuntimeException {
315        InvalidCRCException(String message) {
316            super(message);
317        }
318    }
319
320    public static class InvalidSignedMessageHMACSignatureException extends RuntimeException {
321        InvalidSignedMessageHMACSignatureException(String message) {
322            super(message);
323        }
324    }
325}
